<description>
Remove documentation that says `LogError` should be used for "severe problems that require the node (or a subsystem) to shut down entirely" because:

- It is not how `LogError` and `Level::Error` are used currently. Of 129 current uses only 58 cases are fatal according to [#30348](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/issues/30348)

- "[T]here's not much benefit in a log that says "hey this error is about to cause the node to stop" -- you already get that information by seeing "Shutdown: in progress..." immediately following." according to [#30347 (comment)](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/30347#discussion_r1659096893)

Fixes #30348
</description>

- "[T]here's not much benefit in a log that says "hey this error is about to

  "Shutdown: in progress..." immediately following." according to
  https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/30347#discussion_r1659096893
</commits>
